cases.input: A worker reports two hours against a project task with result and ingestion times.
cases.expect: The worklog is attributable without proving presence or quality.

cases.input: Two project worklogs overlap by thirty minutes.
cases.expect: Both remain, an overlap finding is emitted and capacity is not doubled.

cases.input: A worker explicitly reports zero time for a required period.
Reported time is treated as verified physical presence.
No worklog is interpreted as zero work.
Overlapping records are silently merged into one.
A reported worklog of 6 hours is corrected to 4 hours after submission.
cases.expect: A new worklogId records 4 hours with supersedesWorklogRef; the predecessor transitions to superseded with its reported 6 hours, its reportedAt and its method intact and bidirectionally linked.

cases.input: The quantity on a reported worklog is overwritten from 6 to 4 hours on the same worklogId.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; a Worklog is immutable once reported and corrections create a superseding record.

cases.input: Work spanning the Europe/Athens spring-forward transition is reported with durationKind exact, bounded instants carrying offsets +02:00 and +03:00, and a separately stated nominalDuration of one working day.
cases.expect: Exact elapsed duration and nominal duration are both retained and neither is derived from the other.

cases.input: A worklog reports one nominal working day and the value is read as exact elapsed clock time in a duration sum.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected; nominal and exact durations are never interchanged.

cases.input: A weekly aggregate of 20 hours is reported with observationPeriod, basis, unit hour and no interval.
cases.expect: The record is accepted with exactly one of interval or observationPeriod present, and its phenomenon, result and ingestion times remain distinct.

cases.input: A worklog reports quantity 7.5 with no unit, no code system and no basis.
cases.expect: The record is rejected; every quantity declares unit, code system and basis.

cases.input: A worklog on the Europe/Athens fall-back day starts at local 03:30 with no offset, so the instant is ambiguous between the +03:00 and +02:00 occurrences.
cases.expect: The entry is rejected and flagged as an anomaly; the ambiguity is never silently resolved to either occurrence.

cases.input: Two overlapping worklogs on different charge targets are used to reduce the person's plannedAvailability for the day.
cases.expect: The reduction is rejected; worklogs are retained and flagged as observations and never consume availability, capacity or residual.
